group: EXP-M4-13 R9 desync trailing-word closure (A18 Pro / G17P AGX): proven-safe (b0,b1) 2-byte trailing operand/pad-word length rule + byte+2-conditioned triples on ambiguous pairs + operand_word/pad descriptors. STRICTLY ADDITIVE, per-instance guarded, zero tokenization regression over 1775 own+thirdparty shaders.
kind: length-rule (None->2 additive, (b0,b1) and (b0,b1,b2) gated, successor-guarded) + operand_word/pad descriptors (trailing-word NEGATIVE-RESULT class typed; value un-decoded)
method: 1) Full-corpus census (census resync tokenizer) over 1775 own-MSL + permissive-thirdparty shaders: for every 2-byte undecoded region record its (b0,b1) leader signature. 2) A signature is SAFE iff it is NEVER a named or length_only op LEADER at any clean boundary (0 named + 0 length_only leader occurrences corpus-wide) -- i.e. it appears ONLY as a trailing operand/pad word. 3) Length rule returns 2 for a safe (b0,b1), GUARDED per-instance by _r9_succ_safe: only close when the successor at off+2 is undecodable / a <=2B op / a real NAMED op (never a length_only op of length>2 that the census inner-loop would step over) -- this makes the close mathematically non-swallowing. 4) For AMBIGUOUS pairs (a real leader for SOME byte+2) add (b0,b1,b2) TRIPLE rules only where the triple is never a leader AND the word is genuinely a pad word (pair already named pad_operand, or the collision is incidental & byte+2-separable, e.g. 14 02 = get_sr 1x @ b2=0x12 vs 171 trailing @ b2 in {0x00,0x20}). Real multi-byte op families (fence 0x07, n2_op6 0x?2, isel_reg) are REPORTED, not closed. 5) Descriptors: pad_operand names low-nibble-0; byte0-family operand_word_XX (byte+1 typed imm) names clean byte0; full-pair operand_word_XX_YY (16-bit match) names low-nibble-2/c conflict byte0 without shadowing b_alu14_prep2/mov_imm. CLEAN-ROOM: only own-MSL + committed permissive-thirdparty inspected; no Apple binary; no GPU dispatch; local M4 compile-only for evidence.

lengthRuleEdits.mechanism:
Injected at module scope (after LEN_UNKNOWN): two mutable/data tables and two helpers --
  _R9_SIGS: dict {(b0,b1): 2}  -- proven-safe trailing-word pair signatures.
  _R9_TRIPLES: dict {(b0,b1,b2): 2}  -- byte+2-conditioned safe triples on ambiguous pairs.
  _r9_named_at(buf,off,L): True iff a real descriptor of length L MATCHES at off.
  _r9_succ_safe(buf,q): True iff instr_length(buf,q) is None or <=2 or _r9_named_at(...) --
     the per-instance non-swallow guard.
Injected at the TOP of instr_length (right after b0/_b1/_b2 are read):
  _r9 = _R9_SIGS.get((b0,_b1))
  if _r9 is None: _r9 = _R9_TRIPLES.get((b0,_b1,_b2))
